description: A drug name plus a qualifier of the kind of answer wanted («официальная инструкция», «инструкция»): the drug's own card must stay first, in «Все» and in «Препараты», through the app's lookup path. Regression: «Ибупрофен: официальная инструкция» returned unrelated documents (the qualifier pulled in aliases of «деструкция» and mismatched documents). Run by run-real-corpus.ts; any miss fails --check.
